title: Add explicit --no-color flag to all commands
description: 758 (landed 2026-09-23) added colored blocker/epic indicators with env-based suppression (NO_COLOR=1, CLICOLOR=0, and auto-suppression when output is piped, all verified). The pebble's original ask mentioned an explicit --no-color flag; env-only suppression covers the practical cases (scripts/CI can set NO_COLOR; pipes are auto-detected). An explicit flag would additionally serve interactive users and needs main.rs/wiring coordination across commands. Track as a follow-up rather than scope-creep into 758.
